target: length-31 total-zero sequence with no nonempty zero-sum subsequence of length <=5
context: Such a sequence is necessary for D_4(C_5^3)=31 under the X1-K total-zero extremal reduction. Proving none exists proves 31 in C_0(C_5^3), hence D_4(C_5^3)=30 because 30<=D_4<=31.

symbolic_reductions.multiplicity_cap: every support-point multiplicity is at most 4
symbolic_reductions.support_8: the only pattern is 4^7 3; restoring the missing fourth copy preserves short-freeness, so Property C applies. The support-level dual check enumerates 564 normalized admissible supports and finds zero satisfying -sigma(U) in U.
symbolic_reductions.support_ge_9_saturated: if a support>8 candidate were extendable by one nonzero point while remaining short-free, the resulting length-32 sequence would be Property-C with support 8; contradiction. Hence every support>8 candidate is Sigma_{<=4}-saturated.
symbolic_reductions.pattern_equations: for support s>=9 write a=#mult1,b=#mult2,c=#mult4. Then b+3c=31-s and a=2s-31+2c.
symbolic_reductions.multiplicity_4_projective_isolation: a multiplicity-4 point cannot share its projective line with another support point
symbolic_reductions.four_mult4_span_rank3: four multiplicity-4 points cannot lie in rank <=2 because their 16 terms exceed eta(C_5^2)=13
symbolic_reductions.mixed_basis_rule: if the high-multiplicity seed plus the multiplicity-2 stratum would contain >13 terms in rank<=2, it must span rank3; this authorizes (2,2,2), (4,2,2), or (4,4,2) basis normalizations. The generic checker now fails closed unless the corresponding eta(C_5^2) inequality holds.
symbolic_reductions.rank2_c4_3_outside_point: if three multiplicity-4 points span a plane, then when b>0 and 12+2b>13 at least one multiplicity-2 point lies outside and is normalized to e3; when b=0, rank3 of the full 31-term candidate forces an outside singleton, normalized to e3.

c2_partitioned_replay.note: partitioned node sum is not compared to monolithic node count because each partition re-executes its prefix; equality is required per partition

reproducibility.agreement: all support strata through 22 have independent exact replay; solver output never supplies theorem/novelty authority

bounded_conclusion: Every length-31 total-zero sequence over C_5^3 with no nonempty zero-sum subsequence of length <=5 has support size at least 23.
next_hard_stratum: support >=23; re-derive the normalization before each compute because the eta(C_5^2)-forced mixed-basis inequalities begin to stop holding in this regime
